text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —My, you silly little tanuki, hehe. Please be sure to tell everyone else to watch out for cars too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's almost time for training.
As much as I hate to cut this short, we'll have to stop here for today—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, kitty cat?
Sleeping on my lap is a little difficult right now...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the animals keep piling on, one after another...!
I-I am not a bed, you know~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, she couldn't move from the spot until the animals woke up, and ended up being late for training.
